-- 鍥涘湥銆佸洓榄斻�佸洓绁炪�佸洓浠欑殑鍏ㄩ儴閬撳叿鎺夎惤璁句负缁戝畾锛涘叡鐢ㄦā鏉挎寜鎬墿鍒嗗埆鐢熸晥銆�
for _, monster in ipairs(StdMonster) do
    if (monster.entityid >= 1061 and monster.entityid <= 1068)
        or (monster.entityid >= 1357 and monster.entityid <= 1360)
        or (monster.entityid >= 1391 and monster.entityid <= 1394) then
        for _, drop in ipairs(monster.drops) do
            if drop.type == 0 then drop.bind = 1 end
        end
    end
end

-- BOSS equipment override; shared templates remain unchanged.
do
    local LocalDT = {}
--#include "BossEquipmentDropCfg.lua"
    for _, monster in ipairs(StdMonster) do
        local rule = LocalDT.BossEquipmentDrop.monsters[monster.entityid]
        if rule then
            for _, index in ipairs(rule.disabled) do
                monster.drops[index].propability = 0
            end
        end
    end
end
